queries.name: GetMigrationStatus
decision_tree: if target path does not exist: return NOT_INITIALIZED without creating parent/database/lock/sidecars/logs/defaults
if verified runtime registry/live handshake proves a live host owns target: request authenticated in-process status and return LIVE_* classification
otherwise require the existing soma.instance.lock file; open it without modifying contents and attempt the same OS-level exclusive byte lock used by the host
if inspection lock cannot be acquired: do not inspect database directly; return LIVE_LIMITED/LOCKED_UNVERIFIED unless a verified live handshake succeeds
while holding inspection lock, if -wal/-shm sidecars exist: return OFFLINE_SIDECAR_STATE_UNSAFE without opening/mutating target

while still holding inspection lock and with no sidecars, open database URI mode=ro&immutable=1, perform read-only manifest/ledger/schema/integrity inspection, close database, then release inspection lock
if database exists but lock file is absent: return INSTANCE_LAYOUT_INVALID without creating the missing lock file
prohibitions: no diagnostic emission solely because status was requested
no direct offline inspection while another process can acquire/hold canonical instance ownership

queries.name: GetRuntimeHealth
rules: response run/data identity must exactly match LLD-12 verification expectations
READY is returned only after migration/schema/FK/append-only checks pass

queries.name: GetFoundationDiagnosticsState
rules: counts/technical state only; no domain bodies or sensitive values
does not mutate technical or domain state
diagnostic failure cannot alter authoritative result
